CREATE TABLE haspel_authority_connection (
	id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	device_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	deleted_at TEXT, 
	printer_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	endpoint_origin TEXT NOT NULL, 
	haspel_printer_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	credential_ref TEXT NOT NULL, 
	observed_capability_version INTEGER, 
	observed_owner TEXT, 
	observed_revision INTEGER, 
	observed_pending_count INTEGER, 
	observed_uncertain_count INTEGER, 
	observed_active_count INTEGER, 
	observed_at TEXT, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_haspel_authority_connection PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_haspel_authority_connection_revision_valid CHECK (typeof(revision) = 'integer' AND revision >= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_haspel_authority_connection_times_valid CHECK (length(created_at) = 27 AND length(updated_at) = 27), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_haspel_authority_connection_time_order CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_haspel_authority_connection_deletion_time CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= created_at), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_haspel_authority_connection_endpoint_origin_length CHECK (length(endpoint_origin) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_haspel_authority_connection_haspel_printer_id_format CHECK (length(haspel_printer_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND haspel_printer_id NOT GLOB '*[^ -~]*'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_haspel_authority_connection_credential_reference CHECK (credential_ref LIKE 'ufm:credential:%'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_haspel_authority_connection_observed_owner_enum CHECK (observed_owner IS NULL OR observed_owner IN ('LEGACY_ACTIVE', 'UFM_ACTIVE', 'REVIEW_ONLY')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_haspel_authority_connection_observed_capability_version CHECK (observed_capability_version IS NULL OR observed_capability_version = 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_haspel_authority_connection_observed_revision_range CHECK (observed_revision IS NULL OR (typeof(observed_revision) = 'integer' AND observed_revision >= 0)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_haspel_authority_connection_observed_snapshot_complete CHECK ((observed_at IS NULL AND observed_capability_version IS NULL AND observed_owner IS NULL AND observed_revision IS NULL AND observed_pending_count IS NULL AND observed_uncertain_count IS NULL AND observed_active_count IS NULL) OR (observed_at IS NOT NULL AND observed_capability_version = 1 AND observed_owner IS NOT NULL AND observed_revision IS NOT NULL AND observed_pending_count IS NOT NULL AND observed_uncertain_count IS NOT NULL AND observed_active_count IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_haspel_authority_connection_observed_counts_nonnegative CHECK ((observed_pending_count IS NULL OR (typeof(observed_pending_count) = 'integer' AND observed_pending_count >= 0)) AND (observed_uncertain_count IS NULL OR (typeof(observed_uncertain_count) = 'integer' AND observed_uncertain_count >= 0)) AND (observed_active_count IS NULL OR (typeof(observed_active_count) = 'integer' AND observed_active_count >= 0))), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_haspel_authority_connection_observed_time_order CHECK (observed_at IS NULL OR (length(observed_at) = 27 AND observed_at >= created_at)), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_haspel_authority_connection_printer_id UNIQUE (printer_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_haspel_authority_connection_device_id_device_identity FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES device_identity (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_haspel_authority_connection_printer_id_printer FOREIGN KEY(printer_id) REFERENCES printer (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
)
